User.title: User
User.description: User profile with role-based access control for client and administrator areas.

id.description: The unique user identifier matching Firebase Auth UID.

role.description: User authorization role. Default for new users is client. Elevation to admin requires trusted server/admin operations.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was created.

/users/{userId}.description: User profiles indexed by UID. Users may read their own document, admins may read all documents, and role elevation by regular clients is prohibited.
